'''Centax-1 Maximum Correctional''' was a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] that was located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Centax-1/Legends|Centax-1]].

==History==
During the [[First Alsakan Conflict]] in [[17,000 BBY]], the [[House Juoni]] sided against [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. When Coruscant won the conflict, the heads of the house were imprisoned at Centax-1 Maximum Correctional, where they had to break rocks.
